# Check A02-pit507: the engine on your Windows PC

1. On your Windows PC, download `tatakikun-cli-windows-x64.zip` from https://github.com/allomos/tatakikun/releases/tag/v0.6.2-windows-preview.1 and unzip it.
2. Open Windows Terminal or PowerShell in the `tatakikun-cli` folder (a font that shows Chinese and Japanese).
3. Run `.\tatakikun-cli.exe --packs packs woaini watashi hello chongqizhiqian zhogn`.
4. It should print the same candidates as on the Mac (they are in the release notes): 我爱你 first for woaini, 私 for watashi, hello for hello, 重启之前 among chongqizhiqian, 中 first for zhogn.
5. If Windows warns that the program is not signed, choose to run it anyway (it is a test build).
